title: log_rule_respects_log_level
request: hey, the log_rule method always logs at INFO level even if I pass a different level. can you make it respect the level argument?
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_monitoring_log_rule.py
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+import pytest
+from rich.console import Console
+from smolagents.monitoring import AgentLogger, LogLevel
+
+def test_log_rule_respects_level():
+    # Capture console output
+    console = Console(record=True)
+    logger = AgentLogger(level=LogLevel.ERROR, console=console)
+
+    # This should NOT be printed because default level is INFO
+    logger.log_rule("Default level rule")
+    assert console.export_text() == ""
+
+    # This should be printed because we explicitly set level to ERROR
+    logger.log_rule("Explicit error rule", level=LogLevel.ERROR)
+    output = console.export_text()
+    assert "Explicit error rule" in output
